title: Michael Levin: The electrical blueprints that orchestrate life | TED
summary: Biologist Michael Levin explains the bioelectric layer that coordinates cells to build organs and bodies, showing footage of two-headed worms and introducing xenobots. He discusses implications for medicine and the nature of life.
why: HN commenters use it as the accessible 20-minute entry point to Levin's bioelectricity research whenever regeneration or cell signaling comes up.

quote.text: If you have 20 minutes to watch this ted talk interview I highly recommend it.
